CLIENT WON’T ACCEPT RELOCATION

Company locations in California, Colorado, Illinois, Ohio, Texas and Washington.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Our client is looking for a Data Analyst for their corporate
office in Valencia, Ca. to support business operations through the development of advanced data driven models to collect, analyze, and report data into meaningful business reports to drive informed decision making and improve operational performance. This role utilizes software applications to create queries, analyze data sets, prepare reports and dashboards, and partners with internal teams to increase order review accuracy that will lead to an improvement of cash collection rates, write-offs and Accounts Receivable balance.
This position requires strong analytical skills, advanced Excel proficiency, experience working with large data sets, and the ability to clearly communicate findings to business stakeholders.
The role sits on their business analysis team but is essentially an IT/business analyst hybrid new role.

NOTE:
Very excel heavy; almost expert level using VBA macros, formulas, data management, and SQL.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Create and maintain advanced models (Excel or other application) with complex formulas and business rules
Extract data utilizing queries from AS400 (or SQL) data management system
Partner with internal departments to continuously improve operational performance and models
Develop and prepare customized reports for both internal and external stakeholders, presenting findings in a clear and concise manner
Prepare management reports that highlight operational results and trends
Enhance order review accuracy to improve cash collection rate, reduce write-offs and Accounts Receivable balance
Assist in the implementation of new software application solutions as needed
Handle multiple priorities with aggressive deadlines and ensure appropriate follow-up and closure
Support in the creation and preparation of company dashboards
Complete special projects as assigned, supporting team and organizational objectives and continuous improvement initiatives

QUALIFICATIONS:

BS in Business, Finance, Computer Science or equivalent combination of experience and education
3-5 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, and working with large data sets
Proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Excel (Expert), Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint, Teams)
Advanced proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables, multi-layer IF statements, lookup formulas, VBA a plus
Experience writing queries in AS400/SQL or similar
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and maintain accountability
Strong written and verbal communication abilities
Strong organizational skills, with extreme attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to changing business needs, and meet critical deadlines

$70-90k annually

jobs.title: Project Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Excel Fluid Group

Project Solutions Engineer

This is a fulltime first shift position (Monday – Friday) 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM

Position Overview

The Project Solutions Engineer serves as an in-house engineering resource for the Business Development and Project Sales teams, with a focus on reviewing opportunities early, strengthening technical recommendations, and helping move qualified projects from initial review to a clearly scoped, specifiable solution. This role is intended to provide practical engineering judgment, support customer-facing technical credibility, and help give the buyer or specifying engineer confidence in EFG’s design recommendations.

The position supports the BD team by reviewing project information as opportunities come in, commenting on design considerations, identifying risks or gaps, and helping determine whether EFG’s recommended solution is technically appropriate. The role should keep the BD team involved in the customer relationship while reducing the time spent on detailed technical review, design interpretation, and engineering coordination.

For candidates with Professional Engineer licensure, this role may include responsible review and stamping of applicable project work once the individual has developed sufficient familiarity with EFG’s process, standards, products, and internal controls. Use of a professional stamp must be based on sound engineering judgment, proper review, and comfort with the scope of responsibility.

Responsibilities

Duties would include but not limited to:

Review specifications, drawings, and project data early in the opportunity process to evaluate feasibility, application fit, and technical risk.
Provide practical design comments and engineering recommendations that support BD discussions with buyers, engineers, and project stakeholders.
Help translate customer needs, site conditions, and project requirements into technically sound, cost-conscious system solutions.
Assess hydraulic, civil, electrical, structural, and site-specific considerations to identify concerns before proposals or recommendations are finalized.
Prepare early-stage documentation, including technical summaries, design assumptions, equipment recommendations, review notes, and preliminary layouts.
Prepare design reports, engineering review packages, and supporting documentation for review by external engineers or other qualified reviewers.
Participate in client calls, site visits, pre-bid discussions, and engineer-facing conversations when technical credibility or clarification is needed.
Collaborate with Business Development, Project Sales, internal engineering resources, and external subject matter experts to refine defensible system designs, proposal strategy, and project handoff.
Support responsible engineering review of applicable project work, including stamped work where appropriate based on licensure, review standards, and scope of responsibility.
Maintain current knowledge of EFG products, component manufacturers, industry standards, and application best practices.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or related engineering discipline required.
Active Professional Engineer license required or strongly preferred; Civil PE or PE with directly relevant water/wastewater, municipal infrastructure, pump station, or site development experience preferred.
5+ years of relevant experience in civil, water/wastewater, pump station, utility, or infrastructure-related engineering preferred.
Demonstrated ability to review plans, specifications, submittals, and project requirements and provide practical engineering recommendations.
Comfortable working directly with Business Development and Sales teams in a fast-moving opportunity environment.
Ability and willingness, where properly licensed and supported by adequate review, to take professional responsibility for applicable engineering work.
Solid understanding of pumps, hydraulics, site layout considerations, and project design coordination.
Excellent technical writing, communication, and judgment skills.

Last name*

Phone number*

Resume and/or Cover Letter

Additional Notes

Limitations and Disclaimer

The above job descriptions are meant to describe the general nature and level of work being performed; it is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for the positions.

All job requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health and safety of themselves or other employees.

This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform other job-related duties requested by their supervisor in compliance with Federal and State Laws.

Requirements are representative of minimum levels of knowledge, skills and/or abilities. To perform this job successfully, the employee must possess the abilities or aptitudes to perform each duty proficiently. Continued employment remains on an “at-will” basis.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Salas O’Brien, we tell our clients that we’re engineered for impact. This passion for making a difference applies just as much to our team as it does to our projects. That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

Building for the long-term means that all our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way.

About Us

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more.

Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to life every day.

Core Competencies

Assists Team Manager and team personnel in project and team administration and coordination as requested.
Proficiently operates computer systems and related software programs.
Produces letters, memos, and correspondence such as legal descriptions, agreements, reports, fee letters, studies, ads, proposals, specifications, tables, contracts, forms and all other business typing as requested by team personnel.
Files correspondence and other records.
Maintains project files.
Assists in scheduling meetings.
Distributes incoming mail and prepares outgoing mail for team members.
Prepares miscellaneous spreadsheets, charts, etc., as needed for project assistance.
Has exceptional knowledge of company systems...
Capable of performing specialized functions such as maintenance of master specifications, job tracking system, records management system and other similar duties.

Qualifications

1 to 3 years’ experience or equivalent combination of education/experience.
Demonstrates interpersonal, written and organization skills along with a proven ability to work independently and under pressure.
Excellent spelling and grammar are required and must be proficient in computer/software programs.
Experience in AEC field preferred.

This role is eligible for performance-based bonuses, and comprehensive U.S. based benefits package, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid time off and company holidays
Wellness programs and employee assistance resources
Professional development support

For more information, visit our full benefits overview here – Salas O’Brien benefits

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

Salas O’Brien provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, or local laws. Salas O’Brien will accommodate the disability-related needs of applicants as required by law.
